title: Curated UN regional net migration (2023) and international migrant stock (mid-2024)
source: UN World Population Prospects 2024; UN DESA International Migrant Stock 2024; IOM World Migration Report 2026 chapter 3
license: UN publications; reproduce figures with attribution
note: Static extract committed 2026-09-08. Net migration is WPP 2024 calendar-year 2023 estimates for UN M49 major regions. Stock and corridors are IMS 2024 / IOM WMR 2026. Camp rows are UNHCR operational figures with as-of dates; UNRWA is captioned separately. Border-pressure rows are Frontex EU-external detections (not unique people). Not a live scrape. Stock is not annual flow.

title: World Bank Commodity Price Data (The Pink Sheet), monthly prices in nominal US dollars: Brent crude oil, natural gas (US, Europe), liquefied natural gas (Japan), Australian coal
source: World Bank Commodity Markets (Pink Sheet), CC BY 4.0
license: CC BY 4.0 with the World Bank additional terms for datasets (https://datacatalog.worldbank.org/public-licenses)
note: Refreshed daily by .github/workflows/economy-refresh.yml; the file changes when the World Bank publishes a new edition (second business day of the month). Five of the workbook series, values exactly as published, no unit conversion. These are changes to the source data (selection, month labels written as 2026-09, missing cells stored as null). The World Bank does not endorse this adaptation. Series names are translated on the site by the Fix Planet team. The workbook names third-party providers of the underlying prices on its Description sheet. Provenance, checksums and attribution text: economy/manifest.json.
